summary: IMC Rare Earths Ltd filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report) disclosing operational progress at its Itarantim, Brazil rare earths project, not a special situation. The filing describes a planned mid-November 2026 diamond drilling program at 29 Block D plateau locations to test mineralization below the 30-meter auger limit, and WSP-led in-situ recovery (ISR) field trials at Block A with injection testing targeted for Q1 2027 and 37 groundwater monitoring wells. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated; watch drill and ISR results ahead of 2027 resource milestones.
